attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 8 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and does not carry the «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence — which one entry on this day does carry, and that one was refused. The entry is one sentence and a couplet: the venerable Melania died peacefully; we have no other details of her life. There is no century, no country and no year, so there is no `dates` object and no `locations`, and no hymn is printed. The corpus keeps a `melania-the-roman`, whom the calendars keep on another day and of whom much is known; this is a separate entry of the same calendar on a separate day, and the settled rule that two entries on one calendar are two commemorations is what this folder rests on. The question is named in the reader's report, and the slug carries the day because the page gives nothing else to tell her apart by.
